annotations.title: Risk check for a list of funds

description: For 1 to 20 tickers, what to check before reading funds one by one. Per fund: net assets, fee, top-10 weight, premium or discount, spread, IQ Liquidity Score, leverage gap, closed status. For the list: pairwise overlap, largest fund, issuer and category shares, leveraged share. Pass weights (percent) for weighted shares. Each flag names its number, date and line crossed; none is advice. Unpublished numbers are listed, never read as zero.

weights.description: Optional ticker to percent, for weighted shares.

name: etf_risk_check

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
